lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into longitudinal rows along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Transverse bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the longitudinal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal ridges along the upper third of the flank defined by sharp vertical luminance gradients (bright upper edge, shadowed lower edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs strictly bounded within the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular protrusion or mass located on the dorsal surface of the caudal peduncle, anterior to the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible notch or jagged irregularity on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
